Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Hi-yah!!!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 哈呀！！！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: This not my table!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這不是我的桌子！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Hop Singh's a friend, not a foe! So quit pointing that thing at everyone.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 阿星是朋友，不是敵人！別再拿那東西對著大家揮來揮去了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Main Street is its usual busy self today.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 大街今天一如往常地熱鬧。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: What are you going to do? Holler loud enough for the whole town to hear?
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你打算怎麼辦？扯開嗓子讓全鎮的人都聽見嗎？

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: You'd fall off the balcony if you tried to reach them from here!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你要是想從這裡搆到那些東西，肯定會從陽台上摔下去！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: You can't try that from up here!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你在這上面沒辦法這麼做！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Don't waste your ammo shooting at innocents!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 別把子彈浪費在無辜的人身上！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Caution: the Surgeon General has determined that you've gotten EXACTLY what you deserved.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 警告：衛生署長認定，你得到的下場正是你應得的。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Next time, don't inhale.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 下次記得別吸進去。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Poor, poor Freddy... died for lack of garlic butter!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 可憐的佛萊迪啊……就這樣死於缺了大蒜奶油！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: The Second Rule of the Old West Medicine Chest: Never drink your own mistakes!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 西部藥箱第二守則：千萬別喝下自己調錯的藥！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Next time, try drinking something healthier... like radiator sealant.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 下次試著喝點更健康的東西……比如水箱防漏劑。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Next time, don't inhale!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 下次記得別吸進去！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Rest in pieces.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 屍骨已碎，安息吧。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Guess you're a flatlander.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 看來你就是那種平地來的生手。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: As the town hero, you've been given the sack.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 身為鎮上的英雄，你這下可被炒了魷魚。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: A crushing defeat!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 被壓得粉碎的慘敗！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Rest in pieces, Freddy Pharkas.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 屍骨已碎，安息吧，佛萊迪·法卡斯。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: That's what you get for firing a weapon that hasn't been cleaned since Lincoln was assassinated!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 誰叫你去開一把從林肯遇刺後就沒清過的槍！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Shooting people point-blank is frowned upon in polite society.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在文明社會裡，近距離對人開槍可是很不得體的。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: A bubblin' crude! Blood, that is. Red gold. Tourniquet Tea.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 汩汩冒泡的原油啊！其實是血啦。紅色黃金，止血良藥。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: You come to a sworded end!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你就這樣命喪劍下，劃下句點！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Maybe if you could've caught him red-handed...
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 或許你當初該人贓俱獲逮個正著才對……

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: It's Slime Time!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 黏答答的時刻到了！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Take a burn!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 給你點顏色燒燒！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Coarsegold's shot to hell now!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 粗金鎮這下徹底完蛋了！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: That death is too disgusting to describe!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這種死法噁心到沒法形容！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Dammit, Freddy, you're a pharmacist, not a veterinarian!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 該死，佛萊迪，你是藥劑師，不是獸醫！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: You've sold out. Some Western Hero YOU are!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你出賣了自己。你算哪門子的西部英雄！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: An' that's how Freddy met his ironic ol' death... fum ingestin' horsey products that wuz never meant to be ingested. A few days later, all o' Coarsegold got bought up by some mysterious East Coast consortium, and... well... The rest, as they's fond of sayin', is history.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這就是佛萊迪那諷刺的死法……吃了根本不該吃下肚的馬用藥品給毒死的。沒過幾天，整個粗金鎮就被東岸一個神秘財團給買走了，然後嘛……剩下的，就跟人家常說的一樣，都成了歷史囉。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Too bad about thet, y'know. Guess Freddy's constitution couldn't handle th' noxious fumes that wuz expectoratin' through town. Seems to me a man with his edukashun shoulda known whut to do about a simple bit o'flatulence, but hey, I'm just a simple whittlin' sorta story-tellin' entertainin' kinda guy. And thet's m'story for now. Now git along into bed, it's past yer bedtime.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 唉，說來也真可惜。俺猜佛萊迪的身子骨就是扛不住那股在鎮上竄來竄去的毒氣。照理說，像他那麼有學問的人，該懂得怎麼處理個小小的脹氣才對嘛，不過俺呢，也不過是個愛削木頭、愛講古逗人開心的老頭子罷了。今兒個的故事就講到這，快去睡吧，早就過了你的睡覺時間囉。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: And thet's how Freddy done up and died... from eatin' mollusks without the proper accompanying condiments. And as fer Coarsegold, well, it wuzn't long before it was wiped from the face of the earth. (sob) (sob) (sniffle) (retch)
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這就是佛萊迪的死法……吃了軟體動物，卻沒配上該有的佐料給害死的。至於粗金鎮嘛，沒過多久就從地表上消失了。（啜泣）（啜泣）（抽鼻子）（乾嘔）

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: So, sorry to say, thet's how Freddy Pharkas done up and died. Takin' medication he didn't need were the death of him, and it warn't long afterwards that Coarsegold fell into the hands of... of... Gol durn it, I'm too choked up to tell yuz how it all ended. <sniff>
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 唉，說來遺憾，佛萊迪·法卡斯就是這麼死的。吃了根本不需要的藥，要了他的命，沒多久粗金鎮就落到了……落到了……哎呀，俺哽咽得說不下去了，沒法跟你講後來怎麼了。〈抽鼻子〉

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: 'Course, the rilly ironic thang is thet Freddy shoulda known better'n to drink that arful patent medicine. It wuz like to pourin' a bottle of grain alkyhol down yer gullet. Freddy died jes' a li'l while later, foamin' at the mouth and pointin' at sum purple wild dingos he thought he wuz seein'. Coarsegold came to a nasty end, whut with the... well, I don't like t' talk about it, it gimmee the ol' white trash blues.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 說真的，最諷刺的是佛萊迪應該早知道不該喝那瓶劣質成藥。那味道就跟灌一整瓶穀物酒精下肚差不多。沒過多久佛萊迪就死了，嘴裡直冒白沫，還一直指著他以為看見的紫色野狗。粗金鎮的下場也很難看，那個……唉，俺不想多講，一講就讓俺心裡發悶。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Poor ol' Freddy Pharkas done laughed hisself to death... but the folks of Coarsegold, they wuzn't laughin' two weeks later when the whole town got bought up from underneath 'em. Ol' Willy's done spinnin' yarns fer now. This one always makes me go all teary-eyed and phlegmy.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 可憐的老佛萊迪·法卡斯竟然是笑死的……不過兩星期後，整個鎮子被人從腳底下買走時，粗金鎮的鄉親們可就笑不出來了。老威利今兒個講古就講到這。這故事每次都讓俺紅了眼眶、哽咽不已。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Well, you gots to admit the fella died tryin' to defend his town. Now, we all either hadda leave town or get shot up anyways, so it's not as if Freddy'd done any real good, but it were still excitin' to have him around fer awhile. I guess that story don't end so good. Lemme see, have I told you th' one about the travelin' band uniform salesman and the librarian? Welp, it seems there was trouble in River City, and they had this pool table, and...
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 好啦，你也得承認，那小子好歹是為了保衛自己的鎮子才死的。俺們後來不是離鄉背井，就是照樣挨槍子兒，所以說佛萊迪其實也沒幫上什麼真正的忙，不過有他在的那陣子，倒也挺熱鬧的。俺猜這故事結局不怎麼好。讓俺想想，俺跟你講過那個賣樂隊制服的推銷員跟圖書館員的故事沒？欸，聽說是河城出了麻煩，他們有張撞球檯，然後……

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: So thet's how Freddy's brilliant career done come to a screechin' halt. He sank into the swamp and wuz never seen again. A shame, too, 'cuz the rest of us were kinda plannin' on bein' in the sequel. That ain't one of my better stories, anyhoo. Say, did I ever tell ya the story about ol' King Graham? It seems there wuz this evil wizard, and he got Graham into just a peck o' trouble...
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 佛萊迪那輝煌的前程，就這麼嘎然而止。他沉進了沼澤裡，再沒人見過他。也真可惜，俺們其他人本來還盤算著要在續集裡露臉呢。反正這也不算俺講得最好的故事。對了，俺跟你講過老葛拉漢國王的故事沒？聽說有個邪惡巫師，把葛拉漢害得麻煩纏身……

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Kinda silly, but yep, that's how Freddy died... crushed by a load of bicarbonate while tryin' to put out the fire at the ol' Assay office. The whole town burned to the ground that night, and the British troops got turned back. British Troops? Waitaminnit, I'm getting confused. OH, okay, now I remembers. It wuzn't Freddy that got squashed by them sacks of powder, that wuz sumthin' else. Lemme go back and figger out what actually DID happen to Freddy Pharkas.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 說來有點蠢，不過沒錯，佛萊迪就是這麼死的……在老驗金所滅火時，被一堆碳酸氫鈉粉包給壓死了。整個鎮子那晚燒個精光，英軍還被擊退了。英軍？等等，俺越講越糊塗了。喔，對，俺想起來了。被那堆藥粉包壓死的不是佛萊迪，是別的什麼東西。讓俺重新想想佛萊迪·法卡斯到底是怎麼回事。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Yep, Freddy fell down, went "boom." It were a sad day, we found 'em all squished and not really livin' anymore. 'Course, we had our own problems to deal with, all of a sudden-like. Thet's about when the town of Coarsegold ceased to exist, as we'd done known it. But thet's another story, boys 'n girls. I gots to be alone wif my thoughts fer awhile.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 沒錯，佛萊迪摔了一跤，「碰」的一聲。那天真悲傷，俺們發現他被壓得扁扁的，早就沒了氣。當然啦，俺們自己突然間也有一堆麻煩事要應付。大概就是從那時候起，俺們熟悉的粗金鎮就不復存在了。不過那又是另一個故事囉，孩子們。俺得自個兒靜一靜。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Nope, Freddy didn't quite make it outta that schoolhouse alive. Nope, nope, nope, nope, nope. Nunh-unh. Penelope, she bought up the whole town, or whut wuz left of it after the explosion, and made a fortune with the oil rights. How wuz we to know the town wuz built on oil fields? We didn't even know whut oil wuz! We warn't STUPID, y'know. Just nobody'd told us whut OIL were! Fer corn's sake! Now I'm riled. Go tell yerself stories fum now on. Don't even talk to me.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 不，佛萊迪根本沒能活著走出那間校舍。不、不、不、不、不。沒有的事。潘妮洛普把整個鎮子——或者說爆炸後剩下的部分——全買了下來，靠石油權大賺了一筆。俺們哪裡曉得這鎮子是蓋在油田上頭？俺們連石油是啥都不知道！俺們才不是笨蛋咧，只是沒人跟俺們說過石油是什麼玩意兒罷了！老天爺啊！現在俺可火大了。從今以後你自個兒去講故事吧，別再跟俺說話了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Guess ol' Freddy just warn't thinkin' too well thet day. Them guns hadn't been fired in decades. The resultin' explosion took off Freddy's hands, his forearms, shattered his clavicle and broke his whutcha call your left tibia. He died kinda messy-like a couple hours later. As fer the rest of Coarsegold, well... let's just say it wuz laid to rest not long afterwards.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 俺猜老佛萊迪那天腦子就是沒轉過來。那些槍已經幾十年沒開過火了。結果那一炸，把佛萊迪的雙手、前臂都炸沒了，鎖骨碎裂，連那個叫什麼……左邊的脛骨也斷了。幾個鐘頭後，他就這麼慘兮兮地死了。至於粗金鎮剩下的部分嘛……這麼說吧，沒多久也跟著入土為安了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Yip, Freddy's itchy trigger finger got th' best of him. The sheriff wuzn't about to let Freddy git away with shootin' folks in cold blood. 'Course, the Sheriff pretty much shut down the town a few days later, throwin' everybuddy out inta the street. Never did figger out who he was actin' on behalf of, anyways. And thet's m'story fer now, boys and girls. Mah ol' epiglottis ain't whut she used ta be.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 沒錯，佛萊迪那按耐不住的扳機指終究害了他。警長可不會放過他冷血殺人這件事。當然啦，沒過幾天警長就把整個鎮子給封了，把大伙兒統統趕到街上去。俺們始終沒搞清楚他是替誰辦事的。今兒個的故事就講到這，孩子們。俺這把老喉嚨，也不比從前囉。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: So Freddy were left fer dead, oozin' blood inta the hard-packed dirt of the streets of Coarsegold. Not long afterwards, those who wouldn't git outta their beloved Coarsegold ended up the same way. Life's a real bitch sumtimes, ain't she? Pardon me now, nature's callin'.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 佛萊迪就這麼倒在地上等死，血滲進了粗金鎮那堅硬的街土裡。沒過多久，那些捨不得離開心愛的粗金鎮的人，也落得同樣下場。人生有時候還真是磨人哪，是吧？俺先失陪了，內急啊。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Yip, Freddy met his death at the tip of a sword. Too bad, 'cuz he'd gotten so close to savin' Coarsegold from fallin' into Penelope's mercenary clutches. So Penelope went ahead with her little scheme. She bought up the town real cheap and made millions in the oil industry. She died just a few years back, but she wuz so rich that she had herself froze solid 'til they could find a way to bring her back to life. Ain't that a hoot?
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 沒錯，佛萊迪死在劍尖底下。真可惜，他當時眼看就要救下粗金鎮，不讓它落入潘妮洛普那雙貪婪的手裡了。於是潘妮洛普就這麼把她的小算盤打成了。她用低價買下整個鎮子，靠石油生意賺進幾百萬。她幾年前才過世，不過她有錢到把自己冷凍起來，等著哪天有辦法讓她死而復生。這不挺妙的嗎？

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: ...Mebbe if Freddy'd found sum way to stop "Aces" before he'd won up all the deeds to the town, there'd still be a Coarsegold today. 'Course, Aces weren't actin' on his own, sumbuddy'd put him up to it. Never found out who or why, though. And as fer me, I got outta town by sundown and hightailed it to the Ozarks, where a man kin still be a man wifout other men questionin' me about bein' manly or not. But that ain't neither here nor there. Now get outta here.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: ……要是佛萊迪能在「王牌」把鎮子的地契全贏走之前想個法子攔住他，今天說不定還有粗金鎮在。當然啦，王牌不是自己一個人搞的，是有人在背後指使。不過俺始終沒查出是誰、又是為了什麼。至於俺自己嘛，天黑前就逃出了鎮子，一路跑到歐扎克山區去，在那兒男人還能堂堂正正做男人，沒人管你夠不夠男子氣概。不過這都是題外話了。你現在給俺滾吧。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Now it wuzn't as if Freddy didn't have enuf time to stop them snails, but somehow, he screwed it up but good. The snails ran over Coarsegold and slimed it to kingdom come. Those of us thet wuzn't kilt hadda leave town without bringin' anything with us. I wuz one of the ones that didn't make it. Thet's right, sonny! Yer talkin' to a GHOST! BOO!!! Nyah-ha-ha... <cough> <wheeze> <hack>
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這倒不是說佛萊迪沒時間攔住那些蝸牛，不知怎麼搞的，他就是搞砸了。那些蝸牛橫掃粗金鎮，把整鎮黏得一塌糊塗。沒被害死的俺們，只能兩手空空逃離家鄉。而俺呢，就是沒能逃過一劫的那一個。沒錯，小子！你現在正跟一個鬼魂說話呢！哇啊啊！呀哈哈……〈咳嗽〉〈喘氣〉〈咳〉

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: So 'cuz Freddy couldn't think of a way to put out the fire, all of Coarsegold was in ashes by the next mornin'. The loss of life wuz tree-menjus, but somewhere, sumbuddy was sure happy about it, 'cuz before you knew it... Well, thet's another story, boys 'n girls.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 就因為佛萊迪想不出法子滅火，隔天早上整個粗金鎮就成了一片灰燼。死傷慘重得不得了，不過在某個角落，有人肯定是樂歪了，因為不知不覺間……這個嘛，又是另一個故事囉，孩子們。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: ...and them rowdy cowhands, whom sumbody'd hired to come in and skare folks off a bit, ended up shootin' Freddy and chasin' everbody outta town. And as fer Coarsegold, well, none of us ever found out who wuz behind all the evildoin's. Not that we cared. It warn't that much of a town, anyways. Say, did I ever tell ya the story about a little nose-pickin' brat named Willy Beamish? Welp, it all started in this town that wuz mostly strip-malls...
哈囉，阿星大俠！: ……那些被人請來嚇唬鄉親的鬧事牛仔，後來把佛萊迪給斃了，還把大伙兒統統趕出鎮外。至於粗金鎮嘛，俺們始終沒查出這些壞事背後是誰搞的鬼。反正俺們也不怎麼在乎，這鎮子本來也沒多了不起。對了，俺跟你講過那個愛挖鼻孔的小屁孩威利·畢米許的故事沒？欸，一切都是從一個滿是購物商場的小鎮開始的……

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: That's how it all ended. Freddy'd let the whole dang town die o' the creepin' cruds. I wuz lucky, I stuck to whisky so's I wouldn't get poizoned by the town's drinkin' water. Iffn only Freddy'd used his pharmacological powers fer the good o' the town. <sigh> Then this story'd mighta had a happier endin'.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這一切就這麼結束了。佛萊迪讓整個該死的鎮子染上怪病死光光。俺算幸運，俺只喝威士忌，才沒被鎮上的飲用水給毒到。要是佛萊迪能把他那身藥學本事用在鎮子的福祉上就好了。〈嘆氣〉這故事說不定就會有個圓滿一點的結局。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Look out, Freddy--Injuns! No, wait! This one's an Indian. A REAL Indian. From India! He sits atop an anthill, surrounded by swarms of ants, looking trapped. You feel sorry for him. If there were only some way you could help him.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 小心啊，佛萊迪——印第安人！不，等等！這位是印度人。貨真價實的印度人。來自印度的那種！他坐在一座蟻丘上，被成群的螞蟻包圍，一副進退不得的模樣。你不禁替他感到難過。要是有什麼辦法能幫上他就好了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: An Indian sits atop an anthill, surrounded by swarms of ants. He looks trapped. You feel sorry for him. If there were only some way you could help him.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 一位印度人坐在蟻丘上，被成群的螞蟻包圍。他看起來進退不得。你不禁替他感到難過。要是有什麼辦法能幫上他就好了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Thank you again, Mr. F. I am so much grateful!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 再次感謝你，法先生。在下真是感激不盡！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Oh? Grateful enough to accept the assistant's position I mentioned earlier? I could really use some help out around the shop.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 喔？感激到願意接下我之前提過的助手職位嗎？我這藥局裡真的很需要人手幫忙。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I would be honored! Where do I begin?
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 那真是我的榮幸！我該從何開始？

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Hello, stranger. I haven't seen you around these parts before. I know it's none of my business, but why are you sitting on top of an active anthill in the heat of this semi-desert sun?
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你好啊，陌生人。俺以前沒在這一帶見過你。俺知道這不關俺的事，不過你幹嘛頂著這半沙漠的大太陽，坐在一座活蟻丘上頭啊？

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Oh, my formal fellow, I am but a weary traveler from a land far, far away, journeying here peacefully merely to experience the curative powers of your local mineral waters.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 喔，這位客氣的朋友，在下不過是位來自遙遠國度的疲憊旅人，和平地前來，只為體驗貴地礦泉水的療效罷了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: How cruel those Yosemite-bound tourists are! My name is Frederick Pharkas. I own the local pharmacy here in Coarsegold.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 那些前往優勝美地的觀光客也未免太狠心了！在下名叫佛萊德里克·法卡斯，是這粗金鎮上藥局的老闆。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: How do you do, Mr. Pharkas? My name is Srini Lalkaka Bagdnish. Pardon me if I don't get up.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你好啊，法卡斯先生。在下名叫斯里尼·拉爾卡卡·巴格尼許。恕在下失禮，無法起身相迎。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: (TO SELF) Hmmm, I've been considering taking on a "loyal Indian sidekick!"
哈囉，阿星大俠！: （自言自語）嗯，俺一直在考慮找個「忠心耿耿的印第安夥伴」呢！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: (ALOUD) I'm seeking a new assistant down at the pharmacy? Would you be considering a relocation to this area? You know, Coarsegold offers extremely reasonable housing costs and an abundance of sunny weather.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: （大聲說）俺這藥局在找新助手，你考慮搬來這一帶嗎？你知道的，粗金鎮的房價非常實惠，而且陽光普照。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Well, no, not really, but yes. Perhaps I would be willing. But, as you can readily see, I'm quite busy at this current moment.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這個嘛，不算是，但也算是。在下或許會願意考慮。不過，你也看得出來，在下此刻可有點忙。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Have you considered climbing down and walking away?
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你有沒有考慮過乾脆爬下來，走人算了？

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I can not possibly do that! Life is sacred. If I were to move, I should indubitably injure some of these small six-legged lifeforms. I'm sure someone will come along soon to the aid of me.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下萬萬不能那麼做！生命是神聖的。在下若是移動，必定會傷及這些六足小生靈。在下相信很快就會有人前來相助。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I'll see what I can do, Srini.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 俺會想想辦法的，斯里尼。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Allow me to brush that dust off your robe, my friend.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 讓俺幫你把袍子上的灰塵拍一拍吧，朋友。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: My thank yous are very much, Mr. Freddy!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下萬分感謝，佛萊迪先生！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: May I help you down?
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 俺能扶你下來嗎？

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: While I appreciate your offer of help, I must remain here. I simply cannot harm an ant, and I can presently ascertain no effective means of dismounting this anthill without hurting another living creature.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下雖感激你的好意，卻必須留在這裡。在下絕不能傷害任何一隻螞蟻，而目前也想不出任何能不傷及其他生靈，又能離開這蟻丘的辦法。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: How gracious to offer me an empty can of beans! I am afraid I am having not a use in mind for such a can of nothing.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 你竟願意給在下一個空豆子罐頭，真是太慷慨了！只可惜在下實在想不出這種空罐頭有什麼用處。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I am afraiding the ice pick will not present me with any assistance.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下恐怕這把冰鑿幫不上任何忙。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: The charcoal is a most gracious offer, however I am having no hibachi at this moment.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 這炭真是慷慨的贈禮，不過在下此刻並沒有火盆可用。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Rein? Rein? Go away, come again another day. That is a poem which I just conceived.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 韁繩？韁繩？快走開，改天再來。這是在下剛剛即興作的一首詩。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I do not eat beef, snails, or ham. I do not eat them, Fred, I am.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下不吃牛肉、蝸牛，也不吃火腿。在下就是不吃這些，佛萊迪，不吃就是不吃。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I am not needing empty bottles. I have already evacuated myself several times, with great ceremony.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下不需要空瓶子。在下已經隆重地排解過好幾次了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I am thinking a key is not opening the way to escape for me, though yours is a most gracious offer.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下認為一把鑰匙開不出逃脫的路，不過你的好意在下心領了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: The ladder might assist my situation, however I am not in positioning to maneuver it thusly to facilitate escapage.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 梯子或許能幫上在下的處境，不過在下目前的姿勢實在無法操作它來助在下脫身。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Unfortunately, I am not conversant with the traditional rope-climbing trick of my countrymen, and thus your rope will not be of helpage.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 很不巧，在下並不熟悉同胞那套傳統的爬繩戲法，因此你這條繩子幫不上忙。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I am not caring to be lassoed, thank you! I prefer to die with dignity than be yanked so unceremoniously like a most common livestock.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下可不想被套索套住，謝了！在下寧可有尊嚴地死去，也不願像尋常牲畜一樣被這麼粗魯地拖走。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: A candle wax is a most beautiful thing to become one with, but I am afraid my ability to commune with paraffin has been impaired upon my present situation.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 蠟燭是件能與之合而為一的美妙之物，但在下恐怕以目前的處境，實在無法與石蠟好好溝通了。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I am appreciating the offer now! However, no matter which clothes I am appareling, my predicament remains a puzzlement.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下此刻十分感激你的好意！不過，無論在下穿上哪件衣物，眼下的困境依然是個謎團。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: It will be ready Tuesday. Just having a joke upon you. I know nothing of this claim check.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 星期二就會好了。開個玩笑罷了，在下對這張取件單一無所知。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Wanna put the boots on? That way, at least you wouldn't be walking on ants in your bare feet!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 要不要把靴子穿上？這樣至少你不會光著腳踩在螞蟻上！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: Ah, that is generously of an idea, but I still would end up putting to an end the lives of many precious ants.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 啊，這主意真是慷慨，不過在下終究還是會結束許多寶貴螞蟻的性命。

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I am not caring to read your personal mail right this dying moment!
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下這垂死的時刻，可沒興趣讀你的私人信件！

Hello, Hopalong Singh!: I prefer not to ingest the prescriptions of others, although I am thanking you presently.
哈囉，阿星大俠！: 在下寧可不服用他人的處方箋，不過此刻仍要謝謝你。
